from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Judgment(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document as found in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[Judgment]
